_help: SDR Pilot settings. Every key is optional; delete a line to use the default. Env vars SDRPILOT_<KEY> override these.
_source: 'sdrangel' = your running SDRangel; 'sim' = built-in simulator with test signals
_sdrangel_protocol: 'rtl0' = 8-bit raw IQ, works with no clicks. 'sdra' = 16-bit; then tick 'IQ only' (or choose zlib) in the Remote TCP Sink settings dialog
_dashboard_bind: 'local' = this PC only (reach it from other devices with remote_access.bat / tailscale serve), 'tailscale' = also listen on the Tailscale IP, 'all' = also the home LAN
